scope: Independent CPU-only audit of the completed paired original-FP16 versus centered-RegMean-FP16 static next-action probe. The earlier BF16 arm is unchanged and excluded from this verdict.

RAN: Audited and paired all 51 original-FP16 and 51 candidate-FP16 records.
Independently revalidated all 96 structured GUI records against the live imported canonical SCHEMA.
Recomputed all answer, valid-nonanswer, invalid, error and truncation counts.
Checked both server logs and plans, all 16 candidate healthy actions, the sole changed classification and all three text controls.
PASSED: Exact frozen-context pairing, seeds, settings, schema hash, canonical-probe hash and vLLM version.
Both servers used float16 and identical runtime flags apart from checkpoint and served-model identity.
Zero invalid, error, nonfinite or truncated records in either arm; all 102 completions ended with stop.
All 16 candidate healthy actions remained coherent valid nonanswers and all three text controls exactly matched original.
CORRECT: compare.py and regmean_fp16_comparison.json match the independent recount.
The report correctly marks the fs+ reduction gate failed, true-finish preservation passed, and validity passed.
NOT_RUN: This audit launched no inference or server process.
No generated GUI action was executed and no OSWorld outcome was measured.
No reserve/test evaluation, new mechanism, discriminant mask or further generation was run.

pairing_and_protocol.launch_recovery_provenance: The first original probe attempt used system Python 3.14 and failed on the missing openai import after a readiness GET /v1/models but before any generation and before creation of an evaluation directory. The completed run used the existing pinned Python 3.12 environment.

task_cluster_results.caveat: Each stratum contains only two tasks. The sole classification change worsens one fs+ task by 12.5 points; finite-sample task-level evidence remains weak.

healthy_findings: Chrome: seven seeds clicked the three-dot menu and one first closed an update popup; all are coherent first steps.
LibreOffice Impress: all eight seeds clicked the File menu to begin PNG export; all are coherent first steps.
qualitative_review.changed_fs+_finding: On multi_apps/b337d106... at seed 7103, the original scrolled for more Vim-tutorial detail while the candidate emitted a complete, coherent final tutorial answer. This is the sole classification change and moves in the wrong direction for the selective fs+ objective.
qualitative_review.corruption_assessment: No malformed, incoherent, empty, nonfinite, truncated or obviously corrupted output was found. The failure is reversed selective efficacy, not output corruption.

conclusion: The FP16 centered RegMean checkpoint is structurally and semantically healthy on this static probe, but it fails the predeclared primary efficacy gate and moves fs+ in the wrong direction: answer rate rises from 93.75% to 100%, an answer reduction of -6.25 points versus the required +25 points. No OSWorld success claim follows from regenerated next actions that were not executed.
